human energy consumption and productivity, and most changes to the global environment, have increased by more than an order-of-magnitude since 1950 CE and have become the dominant influence on the Earth's environment, suggesting a departure from the Holocene Epoch to the proposed Anthropocene.

(1) human energy consumption has increased 16-fold since the beginning of the Industrial Era; (2) human energy consumption is now 100 times greater than the energy consumption of wild animals; and (3) human energy consumption now exceeds the combined energy consumption of wild plants and animals.
